Mechanical properties testing: Instron Electropuls E3000 Biaxial
At Medace, we understand the critical importance of reliable and precise testing equipment for characterizing your valuable biomaterials. Our state-of-the-art facility offers access to the Instron Electropuls E3000 Biaxial, a premier mechanical properties testing machine designed to meet the exacting standards of your research needs.
Why choose the Instron Electropuls E3000 Biaxial?
The Instron Electropuls E3000 Biaxial is engineered for precision and reliability, providing unparalleled capabilities in mechanical properties testing. This advanced equipment ensures your research outcomes are both accurate and consistent, making it an indispensable tool for a wide range of applications.
Comprehensive testing services
To support your research, we offer a broad spectrum of testing services, including:
Fatigue testing: evaluate the durability of your materials under cyclic loading conditions.
Young’s modulus: determine the stiffness of your materials with high precision.
Tensile strength: measure the maximum stress your material can withstand while being stretched or pulled.
Ductility: assess the ability of your material to deform under tensile stress.
Toughness: evaluate the energy absorption capacity of your material before fracturing.
At Medace, we cater to diverse research needs. Whether you require our comprehensive facilities or just need access to our advanced equipment, the Instron Electropuls E3000 Biaxial is available to support your specific research requirements.
